person.label: Waiting for your confirmation
person.say: A terminal asks to say to {{session}}, as your words, {{level}}:
person.noSession: {{id}}: Daoris has no session by this id
person.attach: and to attach these files, read from this machine:
person.asker.unknown: Daoris could not name what sent it.
person.asker.help: Ask Daoris asks for this, with the key Daoris handed its conversation.
person.asker.session: Session {{session}} asks for this, with the key Daoris handed it.
person.restored: The record says it was sent by {{process}}, process {{pid}}, before Daoris restarted.
person.restoredPid: The record says it was sent by process {{pid}} before Daoris restarted.
person.restoredUnknown: The record does not say what sent it before Daoris restarted.
person.keyed: This carries a key, so it does not wait across a restart of Daoris.
person.hold: Confirm also lets this terminal speak for you in this conversation until it lets go.
person.view.repository-move: Moves {{repository}} from workspace {{from}} to workspace {{to}}: one row of this machine's registry changes, and no file is touched.
person.view.repository-move-starts: Moves {{repository}} from workspace {{from}} to workspace {{to}}: one row of this machine's registry changes, and no file is touched. No repository is in {{to}} yet, so the move starts it here.
person.view.session-archive: Archives these sessions on this machine: {{sessions}}. Each leaves Sessions' list with its record whole, and Show archived brings it back.
person.view.session-unarchive: Unarchives these sessions on this machine: {{sessions}}. Each is back in Sessions' list, in the group its state puts it in.
person.view.session-delete: Deletes session {{session}}: its record goes, with what this machine kept of it (its words, its transcript and its files), and nothing brings it back.
person.view.quest-delete: Deletes quest {{quest}}: it goes from every list, and nothing brings it back.
person.view.ask-delete: Deletes ask {{ask}} with every quest it became, or refuses whole if one of them has been started on: it goes from every list, and nothing brings it back.
person.view.ask-new: Makes an ask at workspace {{workspace}}: “{{sentence}}”. Its intake turns it into quests, and no work starts before that.
person.view.ask-new-to: Makes an ask at workspace {{workspace}}: “{{sentence}}”, published at once as a quest for {{to}}.
person.view.ask-new-review-on: Its work is reviewed in the default environment before it lands.
person.view.ask-new-review-off: Its work lands with no review first.
person.view.ask-new-review-environment: Its work is reviewed in {{environment}} before it lands.
person.view.ask-new-files: It carries files from this machine ({{count}}): {{files}}.
person.view.work-pause: Pauses the work of {{scope}} {{id}} on this machine: what of it runs now stops as your own stop (sessions running: {{stops}}), and nothing of it starts until you resume it.
person.view.work-pause-already: The work of {{scope}} {{id}} is paused on this machine already, and nothing of it runs now, so this changes nothing.
person.view.work-pause-nothing: Nothing of {{scope}} {{id}} is open or taken on this machine, so there is nothing to pause and this changes nothing.
person.view.account-settings: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s model to {{model}} and its effort to {{effort}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.account-settings-model: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s model to {{model}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.account-settings-effort: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s effort to {{effort}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.account-settings-for: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s effort for the model {{model}} to {{effort}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.place-drive: Drives {{repository}}: a quest for it starts a session on this machine.
person.view.place-undrive: Stops driving {{repository}}: no quest for it starts a session on this machine.
person.view.place-hold: Holds {{repository}}: nothing new starts there until it is resumed.
person.view.place-resume: Resumes {{repository}}: new work may start there again.
person.view.notify-on: Says so when a session parks, or ends without being asked.
person.view.notify-off: Stops saying so when a session parks.
person.view.terminal-act: Every press from a terminal on this machine that no Daoris session owns runs at once as yours, with no card, and is listed in Notifications. Any program you run outside Daoris's agents can then act as you.
person.view.terminal-ask: Every press from a terminal on this machine waits for your Confirm here again.
person.view.cap: Runs at most {{sessions}} sessions at once on this machine, across every repository.
person.view.cap-one: Runs one session at a time on this machine, across every repository.
person.view.cooloff: An account whose limit names no time cools for {{minutes}} minutes before it is offered again.
person.view.quiet: Looks in on a session that says nothing and runs nothing for {{minutes}} minutes; none is ever stopped for running long.
person.view.manifest-files: Stops listing a folder's files at {{files}}: a folder with more is too large to follow, and still works in place, one session at a time.
person.view.manifest-minutes: Stops listing a folder's files after {{minutes}} minutes: a folder that takes longer is too large to follow, and still works in place, one session at a time.
person.view.manifest-copy: Copies a folder for a session working apart only up to {{copy}} MB: a larger folder's session waits and says how to go on, and never works in the folder in the copy's place.
person.view.folder-excludes: Changes what {{repository}} leaves out of its manifest ({{change}}): it will leave out {{now}}, beside the defaults. One row of this machine's registry changes, and its manifest is read again.
person.view.folder-excludes-none: Changes what {{repository}} leaves out of its manifest ({{change}}): it will leave out only the defaults. One row of this machine's registry changes, and its manifest is read again.
person.view.keep: Sets how long one kind of thing is kept: {{rule}}.
person.view.line-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s line: it takes its workspace's again, else the guess.
person.view.line-workspace-set: Sets workspace {{workspace}}'s line to {{branch}}, for each repository there that sets none of its own.
person.view.language-set: Sessions in {{repository}} write to you in {{language}}: a question to you, a closing note, a decline's reason, their last words. The window's own language stays yours, in Settings → Appearance.
person.view.language-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s session language: it takes its workspace's again, else none.
person.view.language-workspace-set: Sessions in each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own write to you in {{language}}: a question to you, a closing note, a decline's reason, their last words.
person.view.language-workspace-clear: Clears workspace {{workspace}}'s session language: each repository there keeps its own, else none.
person.view.standing-set: Keeps a standing answer for {{repository}}, handed to every session there beneath its quest: "{{says}}"
person.view.standing-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s standing answer: its sessions are handed none.
person.view.across-read-on: {{repository}}'s checkout is read by sessions in its workspace's other repositories and by Ask Daoris: its files, git status and the branch list, never a write.
person.view.across-read-off: {{repository}}'s checkout is read by no agent outside it: no session in another repository, and not Ask Daoris.
person.view.across-read-clear: {{repository}} takes its workspace's reading again, else on.
person.view.across-workspace-read-on: Each checkout in workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own is read by sessions in other repositories and by Ask Daoris. A repository with a setting of its own keeps it.
person.view.across-workspace-read-off: Each checkout in workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own is read by no agent outside it. A repository with a setting of its own keeps it.
person.view.across-workspace-read-clear: Checkouts in workspace {{workspace}} are read across again, unless one says otherwise.
person.view.across-write-to: Sessions in {{repository}} may also write into {{other}}: its files, and a commit there, where both are in one workspace with a checkout here. One way: {{other}} writes nothing into {{repository}} unless you declare that too.
person.view.across-write-clear: Sessions in {{repository}} no longer write into {{other}}; a change needed there is a quest again.
person.view.review-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s review rule: it takes its workspace's again, else none.
person.view.review-workspace-clear: Clears workspace {{workspace}}'s review rule: each repository there keeps its own, else none.
person.view.review-none: Declares that {{repository}} has no review environment, whatever its workspace says.
person.view.review-workspace-drop: Stops declaring {{environment}} for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own.
person.view.review-workspace-not-require: Makes workspace {{workspace}}'s review rule not required.
person.view.review-workspace-declare: Declares the review environment {{environment}} for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own.
person.view.review-none-here: No review environment here, whatever its workspace says: work is offered to land once its quest is done.
person.view.review-shown-required: Before work here lands, it is shown to you in {{environment}} and waits for you to say it is right.
person.view.review-instead: A task may ask for one of {{environments}} instead.
person.view.review-optional: When a task asks for it, work here may be shown to you in {{environments}}; nothing waits for it.
person.view.review-local: A set-up step here builds the work in its own tree and shows it in Daoris's browser at {{address}}; your own servers and processes are not touched.
person.view.review-local-run: A set-up step here may run {{run}} in its tree on a port nobody holds, without asking you each time; it stops once you have reviewed.
person.view.review-procedure: A set-up step here follows {{procedure}} toward {{environment}}; each deploy or write there asks your go-ahead once per ask.
person.view.review-waiting: Where work here waits for your review, it lands only once you say it is reviewed, `daoris quest review <quest> reviewed`, or skip the review, `daoris quest review <quest> skip`. No set-up step is composed for you yet.
person.view.review-unchecked: Not checked: {{repository}} has no checkout on this machine; a set-up step sits until its tree holds {{procedure}}.
person.view.review-sits-until: {{repository}} holds no {{procedure}} here: its set-up steps sit until it does.
person.view.opinion-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s second-opinion rule: it takes its workspace's again, else none.
person.view.opinion-workspace-clear: Clears workspace {{workspace}}'s second-opinion rule: each repository there keeps its own, else none.
person.view.opinion-none: Declares that {{repository}} has no second opinion, whatever its workspace says.
person.view.opinion-workspace-set: Sets the second opinion for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own.
person.view.opinion-none-here: No second opinion here, whatever its workspace says: no other agent reads work here before it lands.
person.view.opinion-landing: Before work here lands, the first of its reviewers ({{reviewers}}, in that order) able to read it does, in a copy of its own that nothing is taken back from; its findings go to the session that did the work, and to you.
person.view.opinion-chain: Before a chain's next step starts, the first of its reviewers ({{reviewers}}, in that order) able to read the work of the step before it here does, in a copy of its own that nothing is taken back from; its findings go to the session that did the work, and to you.
person.view.opinion-steps-too: It reads each step's work here too, before the chain's next step starts.
person.view.opinion-verify: It may build and run what this repository declares safe, in that copy.
person.view.opinion-required: If no reviewer can read it, the work waits for you.
person.view.opinion-not-required: If no reviewer can read it, you are told so, and nothing waits.
person.view.opinion-bound: One pass takes at most {{minutes}} minutes.
person.view.opinion-no-recheck: Commits made in answer to its findings are not read again.
person.view.opinion-same-agent: The same agent as the one that does the work here: {{agents}}. A fresh conversation of the same agent is not an independent reading, and each opinion says so.
person.view.opinion-waiting: Where work here waits for another agent's reading, it lands only once that reading is settled, or once you go on without it, `daoris session opinion anyway <session>`, or say you looked yourself, `daoris session opinion myself <session>`.
person.view.opinion-step-waiting: Where a chain's next step here waits for another agent's reading of the step before it, it starts only once that reading is settled.
person.view.opinion-safe-not-handed: What this repository declares safe is not handed to a reviewer yet.
person.view.helpers-set-agents: Sets the helpers rule for {{repository}}: {{mode}}, tried in this order: {{agents}}. $t(person.view.helpers-mode-{{mode}})
person.view.helpers-workspace-set: Sets the helpers rule for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own: {{mode}}. $t(person.view.helpers-mode-{{mode}})
person.view.helpers-workspace-set-agents: Sets the helpers rule for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own: {{mode}}, tried in this order: {{agents}}. $t(person.view.helpers-mode-{{mode}})
person.view.helpers-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s helpers rule: it takes its workspace's again, else each helper waits for your yes.
person.view.helpers-workspace-clear: Clears workspace {{workspace}}'s helpers rule: each repository there keeps its own, else each helper waits for your yes.
person.view.helpers-mode-ask: Each helper an agent asks for waits for your yes.
person.view.helpers-mode-on: A helper an agent asks for starts at once, within the limits: two at once for a session, one turn each.
person.view.helpers-mode-off: A helper is not offered to a session here: only your own press asks one.
person.view.commits-set-convention: Sets the commit rule for {{repository}}: {{mode}}. $t(person.view.commits-mode-{{mode}}) Commit messages follow this convention: "{{convention}}"
person.view.commits-workspace-set: Sets the commit rule for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own: {{mode}}. $t(person.view.commits-mode-{{mode}})
person.view.commits-workspace-set-conven: Sets the commit rule for each repository of workspace {{workspace}} that sets none of its own: {{mode}}. $t(person.view.commits-mode-{{mode}}) Commit messages follow this convention: "{{convention}}"
person.view.commits-clear: Clears {{repository}}'s commit rule: it takes its workspace's again, else work is committed as it goes.
person.view.commits-workspace-clear: Clears workspace {{workspace}}'s commit rule: each repository there keeps its own, else work is committed as it goes.
person.view.commits-mode-as-you-go: Each piece that passes its checks is committed as the work goes.
person.view.commits-mode-ask: Each commit waits for your yes before it is made.
person.view.commits-mode-at-end: One commit is made when the work is done.
person.view.retry-parked: Quest #{{quest}} may be started again, its failures counted on from {{failures}}: what already happened stays in the records, and it parks again after {{more}} more.
person.view.retry-held: Quest #{{quest}} is released from your stop of session {{session}}: the driver takes it up again at its next look, and a later stop holds it again.
person.view.git-use: Signs in as git identity {{identity}} for {{where}}.
person.view.git-use-own: Uses your own git sign-ins for {{where}}, which widens what Daoris's git may use there.
person.view.git-use-clear: Takes back the git identity chosen for {{where}}.
person.view.account-use: Sets how {{agent}}'s accounts are used, for every workspace: {{changes}}.
person.view.account-use-clear: Returns every setting of how {{agent}}'s accounts are used to today's defaults, for every workspace.
person.view.account-order: Puts {{agent}}'s accounts in this order for every workspace: {{order}}. One by one, in order, begins at the first; make the most of them uses the order only to break a tie.
person.view.account-order-clear: Returns {{agent}}'s order to its accounts' ids: {{order}}. No setting is cleared.
person.view.account-ready: Ends the cool-off of {{agent}} account {{account}} now, so starts may run on it again. If the limit still holds, the agent refuses the next start and the account cools again.
person.view.account-ready-own: Ends the old cool-off recorded for {{agent}}'s own sign-in. Daoris starts no session in it; this only clears what was recorded.
person.view.agent-update-pin: Updates {{agent}}: moves its pin from {{pinned}} to the newest release, installed before the pin moves.
person.view.agent-pin: Pins {{agent}} to {{version}}: installs that version where Daoris keeps it, then runs it.
person.view.agent-pin-from: Pins {{agent}} to {{version}}: installs that version where Daoris keeps it, then runs it in place of {{pinned}}.
person.view.browser-use-daoris: Sessions and you use Daoris's own browser, on the engine Daoris ships, from the next time the browser is opened.
person.view.browser-use-edge: Sessions and you use your Edge, on a profile of Daoris's, from the next time the browser is opened. Favorites and the extensions setting are Daoris's own browser's; Edge keeps its own.
person.view.browser-edge-missing: No Edge is installed on this machine, so choosing it would open nothing.
person.view.role-set: Sets role {{role}} ({{name}}): it takes {{takes}}, scoped to {{scope}}. Running work goes on; new work takes it.
person.view.role-appointed-set: Sets appointed role {{role}} ({{name}}), scoped to {{scope}}. Running work goes on.
person.view.role-supervisor-set: Sets supervisor {{role}} ({{name}}): what it decides, who holds it, the acts it is granted and its window, as below. Running work goes on.
person.view.role-choices-off: It is off: no agent takes its work.
person.view.role-remove: Removes role {{role}}: work no role then takes waits until one is given it; running work goes on.
person.view.role-default: Gives role {{role}} back its seed, as Daoris first had it, with its first choices.
person.view.role-default-all: Gives every seeded role back its seed, with its first choices; the roles you added are kept.
person.view.role-policy-set: Sets how role {{role}}'s choices share its new starts, which can spend differently. New work takes it; work already running keeps its choice.
person.view.role-policy-clear: Clears role {{role}}'s policy: its choices run in order again.
person.view.role-policy-goes: Role {{role}}'s policy goes with this change: its choices run in order.
person.view.role-policy-rekeyed: Role {{role}}'s policy is kept, carried over to its new choices.
person.view.second-check-on: After each of Ask Daoris's turns, what it did that you did not say yes to is sent to be read by {{readers}}, in that order. A reading reports what it finds and changes nothing.
person.view.second-check-spend: Each reading is a start on your accounts and spends their tokens: at most {{starts}} starts a day for each choice.
person.view.second-check-spend-open: Each reading is a start on your accounts and spends their tokens, with no start budget on its choices.
person.view.role-rules: Writes the supervisor's rules for {{place}} whole, over the ones it holds now.
person.rules.title: Supervisor: its rules for {{place}}
person.rules.none: No rules of its own here
person.rules.reads: Lines here read these rules at their next go-on or start.
person.supervisor.title: Supervisor: {{name}}, for {{place}}
person.view.plugin-add: Adds plugin {{id}} from the folder below, copied into Daoris's home under its id. Nothing it runs starts at the press: the driver starts it at its next look.
person.view.plugin-install: Installs Daoris's own plugin {{id}}, copied into its home. Nothing it runs starts at the press: the driver starts it at its next look.
person.view.plugin-update: Updates plugin {{id}} from where it came from: its folder is replaced and what it kept stays. The driver starts it again at its next look.
person.view.plugin-update-offer: Updates plugin {{id}} from this install's own {{offer}}: its folder is replaced and what it kept stays. The driver starts it again at its next look.
person.view.plugin-update-same: What it declares does not change; its files are replaced.
person.view.plugin-enable: Switches plugin {{id}} on: the driver starts what it runs at its next look.
person.view.plugin-disable: Switches plugin {{id}} off: it stays installed with what it kept, and the driver stops asking it at its next look.
person.view.plugin-remove: Removes plugin {{id}}: its process is stopped and its folder goes. What it kept stays, for you to throw away.
person.view.plugin-try-again: Starts plugin {{id}} again at the driver's next look, where three unasked exits within an hour held it back.
person.view.plugin-unsound: As it stands it contributes nothing: {{problem}}
person.view.plugin-approve: Approves server {{server}} of plugin {{id}} for Ask Daoris, from its next conversation, with the tools below. A plugin is code that runs as you; an update that adds or widens a tool asks you again.
person.view.plugin-approved-before: It was approved before, and an update has changed its tools since.
person.view.plugin-withdraw: Withdraws Ask Daoris's approval of server {{server}} of plugin {{id}}: from its next conversation it is handed it no more. Approving it again asks you again.
person.plugin.runsNothing: runs no process of its own
person.grant.shows: what Ask Daoris would be handed
person.grant.loses: what Ask Daoris would no longer be handed
person.grant.readsNone: reads with none of its tools
person.grant.writesAccepted: writes outside Daoris with {{tools}}, as you, accepted
person.grant.writesAsked: writes outside Daoris with {{tools}}, not accepted: Ask Daoris is refused it
person.view.browser-links-daoris: Links on the page open in Daoris's browser, from the next click. A sign-in link always opens in the system's browser.
person.view.browser-links-system: Links on the page open in the system's browser, from the next click.
person.view.browser-extensions-offer: Other software's Chrome extensions are offered for your approval from the browser's next start, in Daoris's own browser.
person.view.browser-extensions-refuse: Other software's Chrome extensions are refused from the browser's next start, in Daoris's own browser.
person.view.browser-favorite-add: Keeps {{page}} in the Daoris folder on the browser's bookmarks bar. It shows from the browser's next start.
person.view.browser-favorite-add-titled: Keeps {{page}} in the Daoris folder on the browser's bookmarks bar, as “{{title}}”. It shows from the browser's next start.
person.view.browser-favorite-remove: Stops keeping {{page}} on the browser's bookmarks bar.
person.view.work-resume: Resumes the work of {{scope}} {{id}} on this machine: its pause is lifted and the stops it made are released, and the driver plans its work again.
person.view.work-resume-nothing: The work of {{scope}} {{id}} is not paused on this machine, so this changes nothing.
person.view.history-clear-quest: Clears quest {{quest}} from this machine (sessions: {{sessions}}, teammates' copies: {{copies}}, {{size}}): its words, transcripts and files. Nothing brings it back.
person.view.history-clear-ask: Clears ask {{ask}} from this machine with every quest it became (quests: {{quests}}, sessions: {{sessions}}, teammates' copies: {{copies}}, {{size}}): their words, transcripts and files. Nothing brings it back.
person.view.history-clear-failed: Clears quest {{quest}}'s failed sessions from this machine (sessions: {{sessions}}, teammates' copies: {{copies}}, {{size}}); the quest and its other sessions stay. Nothing brings it back.
person.view.history-clear-failed-none: This machine keeps none of quest {{quest}}'s failed sessions, so this changes nothing.
person.view.history-clear-remote: The remote for {{workspace}} keeps the team's copy; this machine will not fetch it again.
person.view.history-clear-pieces: Some of what it names stays on this machine, each piece for its own reason (kept: {{count}}).
person.view.history-clear-workspace: Clears {{workspace}}'s finished history from this machine (quests: {{quests}}, asks: {{asks}}, sessions: {{sessions}}, teammates' copies: {{copies}}, {{size}}), each judged again as it goes. Nothing brings it back.
person.view.history-clear-workspace-noth: Nothing of {{workspace}}'s finished history may be cleared now, so this changes nothing.
person.view.history-clear-leftover: It also takes {{count}} left-over files no record names.
person.view.history-clear-room: It also takes the intake's room for this workspace: no ask of it is kept.
person.view.history-clear-workspace-keep: It keeps {{count}} of its quests and asks here, each for its own reason: work still open or taken, running, or waiting on you.
person.view.sync-repository: Brings {{repository}} up to date from origin, as you: it fetches each line again, fast-forwards it, replays the branches still at work onto it and deletes the landed branches whose work reached it, each row judged again right before it acts. Daoris never pushes.
person.view.sync-workspace: Brings the repositories of workspace {{workspace}} up to date from origin, as you: it fetches each line again, fast-forwards it, replays the branches still at work onto it and deletes the landed branches whose work reached it, each row judged again right before it acts. Daoris never pushes.
person.view.sync-all: Brings every repository with a checkout here up to date from origin, as you: it fetches each line again, fast-forwards it, replays the branches still at work onto it and deletes the landed branches whose work reached it, each row judged again right before it acts. Daoris never pushes.
person.view.sync-held: Brings every repository that holds a branch of Daoris's up to date from origin, as you: it fetches each line again, fast-forwards it, replays the branches still at work onto it and deletes the landed branches whose work reached it, each row judged again right before it acts. Daoris never pushes. `--all` takes every repository with a checkout here.
person.view.sync-workspace-held: Brings the repositories of workspace {{workspace}} that hold a branch of Daoris's up to date from origin, as you: it fetches each line again, fast-forwards it, replays the branches still at work onto it and deletes the landed branches whose work reached it, each row judged again right before it acts. Daoris never pushes. `--all` takes every one with a checkout here.
person.view.sync-replay: {{repository}}: {{branch}} replays its {{commits}} commits onto its line.
person.view.sync-delete: {{repository}}: the landed branch {{branch}} is deleted, its work on the line.
person.view.sync-nothing: Nothing moves now: every line is where origin last said it was, and no branch waits to replay or go.
person.view.clean-up: Cleans up Daoris's branches in every repository with a checkout here, as you: each session or landed branch whose work reached its line goes with its tree, judged again right before it goes. A branch a running or waiting session holds is kept, and nothing is forced.
person.view.clean-up-workspace: Cleans up Daoris's branches in workspace {{workspace}}, as you: each session or landed branch whose work reached its line goes with its tree, judged again right before it goes. A branch a running or waiting session holds is kept, and nothing is forced.
person.view.clean-up-nothing: Nothing is cleared to go now: the list keeps every branch and says why.
person.view.discard-branch: Discards the session branch {{branch}} with its tree, as you, where a branch of yours holds its commits. A branch a running or waiting session holds is kept.
person.view.discard-branch-in: Discards the session branch {{branch}} in {{repository}} with its tree, as you, where a branch of yours holds its commits. A branch a running or waiting session holds is kept.
person.view.discard-forced: Forced: it goes even where no branch of yours holds its commits, and they are gone after this.
person.view.place-apply: Applies the set-up {{preset}} to {{repositories}} in workspace {{workspace}}: it plans again at your yes, refuses if the plan moved, and makes every change below in one edit of this machine's settings.
person.view.workflow-save-edit: Saves workflow {{id}} ({{name}}) v{{base}} → v{{version}}: work binds the newest version at its first start, and work already started keeps its own.
person.view.workflow-save-new: Saves a new workflow {{id}} ({{name}}) as v{{version}}: nothing follows it until a place chooses it.
person.view.workflow-save-same: Workflow {{id}} v{{base}} already says this, so this changes nothing.
person.view.workflow.drawing: The workflow as it would be saved
person.view.place-opinion: With a second opinion before its work lands.
person.view.place-look: With your look before its work lands.
person.view.place-adoption: Asks each repository's own session, as a quest, to set it up for agents.
person.view.place-adoption-builds: Asks each repository's own session, as a quest, to set it up for agents ({{builds}}).
person.view.place-room: Asks {{repositories}}'s own session (workspace {{workspace}}), as a quest, to give {{room}} a room of its own: {{purpose}}. Nothing is written here: the room's text and its declaration are the repository's own, made on its own branch.
person.view.place-room-alone: {{repository}} is not driven here, so its room quest starts alone while general driving stays off.
person.view.growth-asked: Your switch for new repositories and rooms in {{place}} asks you each time, so this waits for your Confirm even in full access.
person.view.repository-create: Opens {{name}}, a new repository in workspace {{workspace}}, for {{purpose}}. It makes the folder {{folder}} with an empty history on the line {{line}}, its one commit by {{author}}; none of its own content is written, and its own session sets it up.
person.view.repository-create-folder: Opens {{name}}, a new folder department in workspace {{workspace}}, for {{purpose}}. It makes the folder {{folder}} and registers it; a folder department keeps no history, branches or landing.
person.view.repository-create-no-remote: No git remote is made and nothing is pushed: publishing it is yours to do, later.
person.view.repository-create-step-histo: {{n}}. Runs git init on {{line}} and makes one empty commit as {{author}}.
person.view.repository-create-step-regis: {{n}}. Registers {{name}} in workspace {{workspace}} as a repository, not adopted yet.
{{n}}. Registers {{name}} in workspace {{workspace}} as a folder department.
person.view.repository-create-step-drivi: {{n}}. Drives it, nothing held, under the workflow and landing {{workspace}} already follows.
{{n}}. Leaves driving off: the workflow it follows has a {{step}} step and {{name}} has no git remote yet.
person.view.repository-create-step-setup: {{n}}. Asks {{name}}'s own session, as a quest, to set it up.
person.view.repository-create-resumes: It goes on from the unfinished creation {{plan}}: its folder already holds what that made.
person.view.repository-create-quest-work: Then, once that set-up is done, asks the quest “{{title}}”, which opens: {{head}}
person.view.history-clear-workspace-remo: The remote for {{workspace}} keeps the team's copy of {{count}} of these quests; this machine will not fetch them again.
person.cannotTell: Daoris cannot tell whether you ran this or an agent did. Confirm only what you ran.
person.gone: This no longer waits: it was answered in another window, or its terminal took it back.
person.notWaitedOn: No terminal waits on this now; it can read how it ended later.
person.unread: Daoris could not read what this rests on just now; it still waits.
person.draining: Daoris is about to restart; this still waits.
person.drainNothing: Waiting for the work running now to finish, since {{time}}.
person.drainDoor: Install later holds the update for this build; in a terminal, daoris update --cancel does the same.
person.unrecorded: Daoris could not keep your answer just now; nothing was done, and it still waits.
person.changed.session: Not done: the session moved on while this waited (it was {{then}}, it is {{now}}).
person.changed.turn: Not done: the session ran another turn while this waited.
person.changed.setting: Not done: what this would set changed while this waited ({{act}}).
person.changed.repository: Not done: the repository {{repository}} is no longer registered on this machine as it was.
person.changed.quest: Not done: the quest moved on while this waited (it was {{then}}, it is {{now}}).
person.changed.ask: Not done: the ask was closed while this waited.
person.changed.plan: Not done: what this would act on changed while this waited. Look at it again and ask again.
person.changed.branch: Not done: the branch {{branch}} gained or lost commits while this waited.
person.changed.wait: Not done: what this answers no longer waits.
person.adopted: Daoris is using a service it did not start, so your own acts (a review, a yes, an answer) are refused there. Close what started it and restart Daoris.
